help.title: How duplicates are handled
help.email: Same email address: the new details are merged into the existing lead. Every submission stays on that lead’s timeline.
help.phone: No email, but the same phone number: merged into that lead.
help.separate: A new email with a phone number we already have: kept as a separate lead and marked “Possible duplicate”, so two different people are never merged by mistake.

hero.title: Only the leads worth a call, in the tools you already use.
hero.sub: LeadPilot reads every new lead, filters out spam and fake contacts, rates the rest Hot, Warm or Cold with the reasons, and sends the good ones to Slack, Telegram or email. Your team keeps working the way it does today.

arrive.title: Leads arrive
arrive.body: From your website form, Zapier, Make or n8n. Each lead is cleaned and checked for duplicates.

rate.title: The AI filters and rates
rate.body: Spam and fakes are filtered out. The rest get a rating and plain reasons. When the AI is unsure, a person checks it first.

handover.title: Good leads are handed over
handover.body: Hot leads go to your Slack channel, Telegram chat or inbox within seconds. No new tool for your sales team to learn.

trust.title: Built to be trusted with your leads
trust.t1: Each company’s data is kept apart from every other company’s.
trust.t2: Leads arrive over signed, checked requests; repeats never create duplicates.
trust.t3: Tokens and secrets are stored encrypted and never shown again.
trust.t4: A spend limit keeps the AI cost under control, and the rules still rate leads without AI when it is reached.
